title: Forge realms map v7
description: The world an invocation opens, with the offices a provisional model may hold (proposed decision 0075 ruling 5). v1 through v6 remain frozen. This version adds exactly one optional property on the world: provisional_offices, the agents by name a model its adapter marks provisional may be seated in. It never admits a gate. Absent or empty, a provisional model is seated nowhere, and a v7 map that does not name it reads exactly as a v6 map does, the capabilities each realm grants (decision 0065 ruling 3) included.

house.description: Repository-relative Markdown rendered into every seat prompt.

dialect.description: A library dialect name or a repository-relative dialect path.

boundary.description: What stands between a box's hands and this realm's machine (decision 0046 ruling 1): namespace is decision 0043's bubblewrap user namespace (Linux, WSL2); seatbelt the same box built by sandbox-exec (macOS); container a pinned image with the worktree mounted; harness nothing of Brokkr's, the harness's own sandbox as its adapter fragment addresses it; open nothing at all. Absent reads namespace.

publishes.description: The crossings this realm publishes (decision 0057 ruling 1): files this realm owns and other realms may pin. A crossing name is unique within the realm that publishes it.

name.description: The crossing's name, in the realm-name grammar, unique within this realm.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the published file, on the same terms house and dialect are named.

consumes.description: The crossings this realm depends on (decision 0057 ruling 2), each named by its publishing realm and pinned by digest. A crossing name is used once within this list.

name.description: The crossing's name, as the publishing realm publishes it.

realm.description: The realm that publishes this crossing; never this realm itself.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 over the published file's RAW bytes, never over a canonical form: a crossing may be a schema, a .proto or Markdown, and only the publisher's format knows what canonicalising would mean.

capabilities.description: The capabilities this realm grants (decision 0065 ruling 3), keyed by abstract capability name. Absent and empty both grant nothing; everything is off until it is listed here (ruling 4).

additionalProperties.description: One grant. Every key other than dialect, tools and offices is a restriction the selected tool dialect's own schema defines; the engine validates it against that schema and passes it through without interpreting it.

dialect.description: The tool dialect under dialects/tools/ that serves the capability in this realm; its serves must equal the capability's name.

tools.description: A subset of the dialect's named tools. Absent admits the dialect's whole set; an empty list admits no tool and makes no usable holding.

offices.description: The offices this grant reaches: an agent's name, or an inline site's label. Absent reaches every requesting office; an empty list reaches none.

provisional_offices.description: The offices, agents by name, a provisional model may hold (proposed decision 0075 ruling 5). A gate is never among them, whatever this lists. Absent or empty lists none.
